about: The Workbench icons of the BStone drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is BStone's own icon (src/bstone/src/resources/win32/bstone_icon.ico, its 48x48 picture, saved as art/bstone.png), which comes with the GPL source. BStone-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BStone.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BStone.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-bstone, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt.
